# How should organizers read sources?

> `Capital Volume`
>
Start with the passage and its claim.

> **BTW** re: "the passage"
>
> *Why that passage?*
>
> Because it anchors the discussion.
>
> *What if people disagree?*
>
> Let the disagreement name the claim.
>

---

# What should they record?

Record the quote and open questions.
